description: Cancel an appointment slot you booked. The instructor can see the cancellation. Get event_id from list_my_reservations. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true. Apps that can ask the user directly will show a confirmation instead.]

cancel_reason.description: Optional reason shown to the instructor.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

event_id.description: Calendar event ID (numeric string). Get it from list_calendar_events or list_my_reservations.

name: cancel_reservation
title: Cancel Reservation
